def cmd_audit(args) -> int:
    import json
    import shutil
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import agent, audit, outputs, policy, tracing
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .model import BudgetExceeded, gateway_spend
    from .render import RenderError
    if args.all:
        return _audit_all(args)
    if args.budget is None:
        args.budget = 2.00
    if args.county != "panola":
        return _audit_report(args)
    src = None
    if args.resume:
        resume = _latest_closed_run() if args.resume == "latest" else args.resume
        src = Path("runs") / str(resume) / "ledger.sqlite"
        if not resume or not src.exists():
            print(f"no closed run to resume from ({src})", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
    except sources.FetchError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note)
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    t0 = time.time()
    started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    run_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    log = lambda *a: print(*a, flush=True)
    phases, sample, summary, stopped, reader = {}, None, None, None, None
    gw = audit.AuditGateway(budget=args.budget)
    try:
        if src:
            shutil.copy(src, out / "ledger.sqlite")           # the run resumed from is never changed
            led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
            src_json = src.parent / args.county / "county.json"
            if src_json.exists():
                old = json.loads(src_json.read_text())
                summary, sample = old.get("summary"), old.get("sample")
            print(f"run {run_id}: auditing {args.county} on the ledger of {src.parent.name} (no new read)")
        else:
            led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
            print(f"run {run_id}: reading, closing and auditing {args.county}, run budget ${args.budget:.2f}")
            t1 = time.time()
            s_read = matrix.read_county(args.county, gw, led, run_id=run_id, model="auto", log=log)
            phases["read"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
            sample = s_read.get("sample")
            if s_read["stopped"]:
                print(s_read["stopped"], file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
        cols = matrix.precinct_order(led, args.county)
        if not cols:
            print("the ledger has no header block (registered voters row); nothing to place columns by", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        geo = matrix.Geometry(args.county, cols)
        chosen = next((json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in reversed(led.events(args.county))
                       if e["kind"] == "choose_reader"), None)
        reader = (chosen or {}).get("reader") or "claude-haiku"
        sample = sample or chosen
        gw.model = reader
        t1 = time.time()
        closed = agent.close_county(args.county, gw, led, geo, run_id=run_id, reader=reader, log=log)
        agent.finalize_open(led, args.county)
        phases["close"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
        summary = dict(summary if src and summary else closed)
        cs = led.cells(args.county)
        summary.update(cells_accepted=sum(c["status"] == "accepted" for c in cs),
                       cells_cannot_verify=sum(c["status"] == "cannot_verify" for c in cs),
                       cells_document_inconsistent=sum(c["status"] == "document_inconsistent" for c in cs),
                       cells_open=sum(c["status"] not in ("accepted", "cannot_verify", "document_inconsistent")
                                      for c in cs))
        stopped = closed["stopped"]
        if not stopped:
            outputs.fill_boxes(led, args.county, geo)
            t1 = time.time()
            pol = policy.write_for_run(out)
            rows = sources.read_published(args.county)
            fname = sources.file_url(args.county).rsplit("/", 1)[1]
            raw = sources.file_path(args.county).read_bytes()
            res = audit.audit_county(args.county, led, geo, gw, rows, run_dir=out, log=log, run_id=run_id, file_name=fname)
            phases["audit"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
            outputs.make_group_crops(args.county, res, geo)
            outputs.write_county(out, args.county, run_id, led, geo, summary)
            d = outputs.write_findings(out, args.county, run_id, res, policy=pol, raw_file=raw, file_name=fname,
                                       file_urls={"scan": sources.scan_url(args.county), "file": sources.file_url(args.county)},
                                       verdicts=led.verdicts(args.county))
    except BudgetExceeded as e:
        stopped = str(e)
        print(f"stopped: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    except RenderError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    spend = None
    try:
        after = gateway_spend()[0]
        spend = {"before": before, "after": after, "change": round(after - before, 4)}
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    outputs.write_audit_run(out, run_id, started=started, ended=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), seconds=seconds,
                            command="crossfoot " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:]), county=args.county, gw=gw,
                            reader=reader, sample=sample, resumed_from=(src.parent.name if src else None),
                            phases=phases, spend=spend)
    if stopped:
        print("the run stopped before the audit finished; nothing was written beyond run.json", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    _print_audit(d, gw, spend, seconds, out, args.county, reader)
    return 0


def _audit_all(args) -> int:
    """`audit --all`: every county in a fixed order, no input, one budget; --resume <run_id> continues that run's folder."""
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import allrun, audit, outputs, tracing
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .model import gateway_spend
    resume = args.resume
    if resume == "latest":
        found = sorted(p.parent.name for p in Path("runs").glob("*/summary.json"))
        resume = found[-1] if found else None
    if args.resume and not (resume and (Path("runs") / resume / "summary.json").exists()):
        print(f"no run with a summary.json to resume from (runs/{resume or args.resume})", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    run_id = resume or time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note, flush=True)
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    log = lambda *a: print(*a, flush=True)
    budget = args.budget if args.budget is not None else 9.00
    gw = audit.AuditGateway(budget=budget)
    led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
    started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    counties = only_counties(args.only)
    log(f"run {run_id}: auditing {', '.join(counties)}{' (continuing)' if resume else ''}, run budget ${budget:.2f}")
    try:
        summary = allrun.run_all(out, run_id, gw, led, allrun.audit_one, resume=bool(resume), log=log, counties=counties,
                                 command="crossfoot " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:]), budget=budget, started=started)
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    try:
        after = gateway_spend()[0]
        summary["gateway_spend"] = {"before": before, "after": after, "change": round(after - before, 4)}
        allrun.write_summary(out, summary)
        log(f"gateway spend: ${before:.4f} -> ${after:.4f} (change ${after - before:.4f})")
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    outputs.write_run(out, run_id, started=started, ended=summary["ended"], command=summary["command"],
                      counties=list(counties), gw=gw, resumed_from=resume)
    t = summary["totals"]
    log(f"{t['closed']} of {t['counties']} counties closed; model calls {t['model_calls']}; metered cost (estimate) "
        f"${t['metered_cost']:.4f}; seconds {t['seconds']}")
    if summary["not_reached"]:
        log(f"not reached: {', '.join(summary['not_reached'])}")
    log(f"written: {out / 'summary.json'}, {out / 'summary.md'}")
    return 0 if t["closed"] == t["counties"] else 2

                phases["audit"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)

                outputs.write_county(out, county, run_id, led, geo, summary, layout="report")

def cmd_verify_known(args) -> int:
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    known = Path("tests") / f"known_{args.county}.json"
    runs = sorted(p for p in Path("runs").glob(f"*/{args.county}/findings.json"))
    if not known.exists() or not runs:
        print(f"need {known} and a run with {args.county}/findings.json", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    want = json.loads(known.read_text())["expected"]
    d = json.loads(runs[-1].read_text())
    fs = d["findings"]
    missing = []
    for e in want:
        hit = [f for f in fs if (not e.get("kind") or f["kind"] == e["kind"]) and
               e.get("office_contains", "").lower() in f["office"].lower() and
               e.get("candidate_contains", "").lower() in f["candidate"].lower() and
               (not e.get("precinct") or f["precinct"] == e["precinct"])]
        if not hit:
            missing.append(e)
    found = len(want) - len(missing)
    print(f"findings file: {runs[-1]}")
    print(f"expected {len(want)}, found {found}, findings in all {len(fs)}")
    for e in missing:
        print(f"  missing: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if missing else 0

def only_counties(text):
    """`--only a,b`: the counties of an --all run, in the run's fixed order; an unknown name stops the command."""
    from . import allrun
    if not text:
        return allrun.ORDER
    want = [c.strip() for c in text.split(",") if c.strip()]
    bad = [c for c in want if c not in allrun.ORDER]
    if bad:
        raise SystemExit(f"--only: unknown county {', '.join(bad)} (known: {', '.join(allrun.ORDER)})")
    return tuple(c for c in allrun.ORDER if c in want)


def cmd_summarize(args) -> int:
    """Rebuild a summary over all counties from the newest result of each, in a new run folder."""
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import allrun
    src = {}
    for item in args.use:
        county, _, run = item.partition("=")
        if county not in allrun.ORDER or not run:
            print(f"--use takes county=run_id (known counties: {', '.join(allrun.ORDER)}), got {item!r}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        src[county] = run
    out = Path("runs") / (args.run_id or time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    s = allrun.combine(out, args.base, src, command="crossfoot " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:]))
    print(f"written: {out / 'summary.json'}, {out / 'summary.md'}; {s['totals']['closed']} of "
          f"{s['totals']['counties']} counties closed")
    return 0


def cmd_score(args) -> int:
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    from . import score, sources
    runs = sorted(p.parent.parent.name for p in Path("runs").glob(f"*/{args.county}/findings.json")
                  if (p.parent / "county.json").exists())
    run = runs[-1] if args.resume == "latest" and runs else args.resume
    src = Path("runs") / run / args.county / "findings.json"
    if not src.exists():
        print(f"no audit of {args.county} to score against ({src})", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    audit_doc = json.loads(src.read_text())
    claims_path = Path(args.findings)
    claims = json.loads(claims_path.read_text())
    res = score.score(claims, audit_doc["findings"], sources.read_published(args.county), audit_doc.get("not_compared") or [])
    res = {"county": args.county, "claims_file": str(claims_path), "audit_run": run, "audit_findings_file": str(src),
           "audit_side": score.audit_side(run, args.county), **res}
    out = claims_path.parent / "score.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1) + "\n")
    c = res["counts"]
    print(f"claims {c['claims']} scored against the audit of {args.county} (run {run}: {res['audit_findings']} findings, "
          f"{res['audit_settled']} settled)")
    for g in score.GROUPS:
        print(f"  {g}: {c[g]}")
    print(f"  audit's settled findings the list does not contain: {len(res['missed_settled'])}")
    print(f"written: {out}")
    return 0

def build_parser():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="crossfoot")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    for name, fn, h in (("fetch", cmd_fetch, "download a county's scan and published file"),
                        ("filecheck", cmd_filecheck, "list published rows whose votes differ from their parts")):
        s = sub.add_parser(name, help=h)
        g = s.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
        g.add_argument("--county", choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
        g.add_argument("--all", action="store_true")
        s.set_defaults(fn=fn)
    s = sub.add_parser("render", help="render one scan page to PNG")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--page", type=int, required=True)
    s.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=200)
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_render)
    s = sub.add_parser("read", help="first read of a county's scan into a new run's ledger")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=2.00, help="dollars this run may meter (default 2.00)")
    s.add_argument("--pages", help="comma-separated pages, default all (the sample of --model auto always reads page 1)")
    s.add_argument("--model", default="auto", help="auto (default): read a sample of page 1 with claude-haiku and choose "
                   "the reader by how many of its row sums fail; or a model name, which skips the sample")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_read)
    s = sub.add_parser("read-page", help="read pages a first read failed on into a copy of that run's ledger")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--into", required=True, help="run id whose ledger is copied into a new run")
    s.add_argument("--pages", required=True, help="comma-separated pages")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=0.30, help="dollars this run may meter (default 0.30)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_read_page)
    s = sub.add_parser("close", help="work every failing sum of a first-read ledger until each cell is accepted or "
                                     "cannot_verify")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--resume", required=True, help="run id whose ledger is copied into a new run, or 'latest' for the "
                   "newest read (a run with a first-read.json)")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1.50, help="dollars this run may meter (default 1.50)")
    s.add_argument("--max-items", type=int, help="work at most this many failing sums (for trials)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_close)
    s = sub.add_parser("audit", help="read (or reuse a ledger), close it, compare it with the published file, write "
                                     "findings, a corrected file, a diff and a report")
    g = s.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--county", choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    g.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="every county in turn, no input; --resume <run_id> continues "
                   "that run in its own folder")
    s.add_argument("--only", help="with --all: only these counties, comma-separated (e.g. san_saba,cottle)")
    s.add_argument("--resume", help="run id whose ledger is reused instead of reading again, or 'latest' for the "
                   "newest run with a county.json (with --all: the run to continue)")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=None, help="dollars this run may meter (default 2.00 for a county, "
                   "9.00 with --all)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_audit)
    s = sub.add_parser("verify-known", help="check the newest findings.json against the answer key in tests/")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_verify_known)
    s = sub.add_parser("score", help="score a claimed list of disagreements against the newest audit's findings")
    s.add_argument("--findings", required=True, help="json list of {office, candidate, precinct, part, file_value, scan_value}")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--resume", default="latest", help="run id of the audit to score against, or 'latest'")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_score)
    s = sub.add_parser("policy", help="the one question the audit asks a person")
    s.add_argument("action", choices=["set", "show"])
    s.add_argument("--answer", help="cells or totals (with `set`)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_policy)
    s = sub.add_parser("budget", help="print the gateway's spend and limit for the key")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_budget)

def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    return args.fn(args)

79	def ink_box(im, box, shrink=INK_SHRINK, below=INK_BELOW):
80	    """The bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the ink inside `box` of the grey image `im`, the box shrunk by `shrink`
81	    pixels on every side; None when there is no ink."""
82	    x0, y0 = max(0, int(box[0] + shrink)), max(0, int(box[1] + shrink))
83	    x1, y1 = min(im.width, int(box[2] - shrink)), min(im.height, int(box[3] - shrink))
84	    if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
85	        return None
86	    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
87	    dark = im.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1)).point(lambda v: 255 if v < below else 0)
88	    # ruled lines run the whole way across the box; a figure's own strokes do not: take those lines out first
89	    cols = dark.resize((dark.width, 1), Image.BOX).tobytes()
90	    rows = dark.resize((1, dark.height), Image.BOX).tobytes()
91	    pen = ImageDraw.Draw(dark)
92	    for x, v in enumerate(cols):
93	        if v >= RULE_FRACTION * 255:
94	            pen.rectangle([x - RULE_FRINGE, 0, x + RULE_FRINGE, dark.height], fill=0)
95	    for y, v in enumerate(rows):

98	    ink = dark.getbbox()

362	    top = lambda k: (k[0], strips[(k[0], k[1])][[s[0] for s in strips[(k[0], k[1])]].index(k[2])][1])
363	    crops, totals = sorted(crops, key=top), sorted(totals, key=top)
364	    for (p, b, r) in totals:
365	        im, K, inkrow, rows, i, vals = place(p, b, r)
366	        boxes, _, _ = figure_boxes(im, [0, rows[i][1], rows[i][3], rows[i][2]], values=vals)
367	        keep_fx(p, b, r, boxes, sc_of(p) / K)
368	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
369	    for (p, b, r) in crops:
370	        im, K, inkrow, rows, i, vals = place(p, b, r)
371	        f = sc_of(p) / K
372	        x1 = rows[i][3]
373	        pieces = row_pieces([(a, c) for _, a, c, _ in rows], i, inkrow)
374	        crop, parts = cut_pieces(im, pieces, x1 + 8)
375	        n = len(rc)
376	        crop.save(out_dir / f"{county}-r{n}.webp", quality=84, method=6)
377	        boxes, lb, fh = figure_boxes(im, [0, rows[i][1], x1, rows[i][2]], values=vals)
378	        keep_fx(p, b, r, boxes, f)
379	        mid = (rows[i][1] + rows[i][2]) / 2
380	        piece = next(pt for pt in parts if pt[0] <= mid <= pt[1])
381	        ry0 = piece[2] + max(0, rows[i][1] - piece[0]) if rows[i][1] >= piece[0] else piece[2]
382	        ry1 = piece[2] + min(piece[1], rows[i][2]) - piece[0]
383	        fb = {}
384	        for c, bx in boxes.items():
385	            u, w = (to_crop(parts, bx[0], bx[1]), to_crop(parts, bx[2], bx[3])) if bx else (None, None)
386	            fb[c] = [u[0], u[1], w[0], w[1]] if u and w else None
387	        lbc = lb if lb else None
388	        # where the rows begin in the crop: the second piece, or the first row of a crop in one piece
389	        fr = parts[1][2] if len(parts) == 2 else max(0, rows[0][1] - parts[0][0])
390	        ch = None      # where the column headings start: the loupe can open on them
391	        h0, h1 = parts[0][0], (parts[0][1] if len(parts) == 2 else rows[0][1])
392	        fl = min((bx[0] for bx in boxes.values() if bx), default=None)
393	        # the headings of the figures' columns: ink right of the label's side only, so the title and "Vote For" are left out
394	        seg = (_dark(im, [fl - 30, h0, x1, h1])[0].sum(axis=1) >= 3) if fl is not None and h1 > h0 else (inkrow[h0:h1] if h1 > h0 else [])
395	        y = len(seg) - 1
396	        while y >= 0 and not seg[y]:
397	            y -= 1
398	        if y >= 0:
399	            ytop, blank = y, 0
400	            for yy in range(y, -1, -1):
401	                if seg[yy]:
402	                    ytop, blank = yy, 0
403	                else:
404	                    blank += 1
405	                    if blank >= 24:      # more than the gap between the two lines of "Early Voting"
406	                        break
407	            ch = max(0, ytop - 8)
408	        # the blank bands between the lines of the crop (their middles): a window of the loupe opens and closes on them
409	        cd = np.asarray(crop) < INK_BELOW
410	        inked = cd.sum(axis=1) >= 3
411	        gp, run = [], 0
412	        for yy, hit in enumerate(list(inked) + [True]):
413	            if hit:
414	                if run >= 4:
415	                    gp.append(yy - run // 2 - 1)
416	                run = 0
417	            else:
418	                run += 1
419	        rc.append({"id": n, "p": p, "b": b, "r": r, "img": img_path(county, n), "w": crop.width, "h": crop.height,
420	                   "parts": parts, "pb": [0, round(min(a for a, _, _ in parts) * f, 1), round(crop.width * f, 1),
421	                                          round(max(c for _, c, _ in parts) * f, 1)],
422	                   "rb": [0, ry0, crop.width, ry1], "fb": fb, "lb": lbc, "fh": fh, "ch": ch, "fr": fr, "gp": gp})
423	        index[(p, b, r)] = n
424	    return rc, fx, index

447	def report_rows(items: list, findings: list, scan_fig: dict) -> None:
448	    """`rv` of each item of a report county: {file, scan}, the row's four figures (total, absentee, early voting, election
449	    day; null for a figure the file or the scan does not have). The scan's are the ledger's; the file's are the scan's with
450	    the file's value at each place a finding of the same row names one. A row only the file has takes the file's own."""
451	    by_row = {}
452	    for it, f in zip(items, findings):
453	        if f.get("page") is not None and f.get("row"):
454	            by_row.setdefault((f["page"], f["block"], f["row"]), []).append(f)
455	    for it, f in zip(items, findings):
456	        rows = (f.get("row_values") or {})
457	        if rows.get("file") or rows.get("scan"):
458	            order = {"votes": 0, "absentee": 1, "early_voting": 2, "election_day": 3}
459	            pick = lambda d: [d.get(k) for k in order] if d else None
460	            it["rv"] = {"file": pick(rows.get("file")), "scan": pick(rows.get("scan"))}
461	            continue
462	        key = (f.get("page"), f.get("block"), f.get("row"))
463	        if key not in by_row:
464	            continue
465	        scan = [scan_fig.get((*key, c)) for c in COLS]
466	        file = list(scan)
467	        for g in by_row[key]:
468	            c = PART_COL.get(g.get("part"))
469	            if c in COLS and g.get("file_value") is not None:
470	                file[COLS.index(c)] = g["file_value"]
471	            elif c in COLS:
472	                file[COLS.index(c)] = None
473	        it["rv"] = {"file": file, "scan": scan}

476	def build_findings(raw: dict, index: dict, doc: dict, run: dict | None = None, path=None, evidence=None,
477	                   crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: None, rcix=None) -> dict:
478	    """The `fd` part of the county's JSON from a findings.json (`doc`), the run's run.json (`run`) and the county's
479	    values (`index`: (page, block, row, column) -> index into values). See the module's docstring."""
480	    county = raw["county"]
481	    report = raw.get("layout") == "report"
482	    rcix = rcix or {}
483	    blocks = {b["id"]: b for b in raw["blocks"]}
484	    scan_fig = {(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], c["column"]): c["value"] for c in raw["cells"]} if report else {}
485	    boxed = [(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c.get("box")) for c in raw["cells"]] + \
486	            [(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t.get("box")) for t in raw["totals"]]
487	
488	    def label(bid, f=None):
489	        if report:   # a block is a whole contest: the row is the label the finding names, as printed on the scan
490	            return (f or {}).get("row") or (f or {}).get("candidate") or (f or {}).get("office") or None
491	        b = blocks.get(bid)
492	        if b and (b.get("candidate") or b.get("contest")):
493	            return b.get("candidate") or b["contest"]
494	        return (f or {}).get("candidate") or (f or {}).get("office") or None
495	
496	    def ref_of(f):
497	        """The finding's value on the sheet: the cell the audit compares (as crossfoot.audit.entity_key), else the
498	        value whose box is the finding's box."""
499	        p, b, part, pr = f.get("page"), f.get("block"), f.get("part"), str(f.get("precinct"))
500	        if report:
501	            k = (p, b, f.get("row"), PART_COL.get(part))
502	            return index.get(k)
503	        if part == "votes":
504	            keys = [(p, b, "REGISTERED", pr)] if b == "reg" else [(p, b, "col", pr)]
505	        else:
506	            keys = [(p, b, SCAN_ROW.get(part), pr)]
507	        for k in keys:
508	            if k in index:
509	                return index[k]
510	        for (bp, bb, r, c, box) in boxed:
511	            if (bp, bb) == (p, b) and _same_box(box, f.get("box")) and (bp, bb, r, c) in index:
512	                return index[(bp, bb, r, c)]
513	        return None
514	
515	    items = []
516	    for f in doc["findings"]:
517	        it = {"id": f["id"], "group": f.get("group"), "kind": f["kind"], "status": f["status"]}
518	        for k, v in (("office", f.get("office")), ("row", label(f.get("block"), f)), ("precinct", f.get("precinct")),
519	                     ("part", f.get("part")), ("file", f.get("file_value")), ("scan", f.get("scan_value")),
520	                     ("reason", f.get("reason")), ("page", f.get("page")), ("block", f.get("block"))):
521	            if v is not None and v != "":
522	                it[k] = v
523	        r = ref_of(f)
524	        if r is not None:
525	            it["ref"] = r
526	        if f.get("reread_disagrees"):
527	            it["reread_disagrees"] = True
528	            rv = (f.get("reread") or {}).get("value")
529	            if rv is not None:
530	                it["reread_value"] = rv
531	        it["sums"] = []
532	        for s in f.get("sums") or []:
533	            d = {"kind": s["kind"], "name": s["name"]}
534	            for k, v in (("label", s.get("printed_label")), ("printed", s.get("printed")),
535	                         ("with_file", s.get("computed_with_file")), ("with_scan", s.get("computed_with_scan")),
536	                         ("holds_file", s.get("holds_with_file")), ("holds_scan", s.get("holds_with_scan"))):
537	                if v is not None:
538	                    d[k] = v
539	            d["terms"] = [[index.get((t["cell"][0], t["cell"][1], t["cell"][2], str(t["cell"][3]))), t["value"]]
540	                          for t in s.get("terms") or []]
541	            it["sums"].append(d)
542	        if f.get("confirmed_by_person"):
543	            it["confirmed_by_person"] = True
544	        if report:
545	            report_item(it, f, scan_fig, rcix, index)
546	        items.append(it)
547	    if report:
548	        report_rows(items, doc["findings"], scan_fig)
549	
550	    groups = []
551	    for g in doc.get("groups") or []:
552	        d = {"id": g["id"], "kind": g["kind"], "findings": list(g.get("findings") or [])}
553	        first = next((f for f in doc["findings"] if f["id"] in d["findings"]), None) if report else None
554	        for k, v in (("office", g.get("office")), ("row", label(g.get("block"), first or g)), ("precincts", g.get("precincts")),
555	                     ("page", g.get("page")), ("block", g.get("block")),
556	                     ("crop", crop_path(county, g["id"], g.get("crop")))):
557	            if v not in (None, "", []):
558	                d[k] = v
559	        groups.append(d)
560	
561	    counts = dict(doc.get("counts") or {})
562	    counts["confirmed"] = sum(1 for f in doc["findings"] if f.get("confirmed_by_person"))
563	    fd = {"run": doc.get("run_id") or raw["run_id"], "counts": counts, "groups": groups, "items": items}
564	    if path:
565	        fd["path"] = path
566	    if evidence:
567	        fd["evidence"] = evidence
568	    if doc.get("sums_check"):
569	        fd["sums_check"] = doc["sums_check"]
570	
571	    cells = raw["cells"]
572	    fig = {"cells": len(cells),
573	           "right_first": sum(1 for c in cells if c["status"] == "accepted" and not c.get("tries")),
574	           "right_after": sum(1 for c in cells if c["status"] == "accepted" and c.get("tries")),
575	           "disagreements": len(items),
576	           "settled": sum(1 for i in items if i["status"] == "settled_against_file")}
577	    rr = (raw.get("summary") or {}).get("cells_reread")
578	    if rr is not None:
579	        fig["reread"] = rr
580	    fd["figures"] = fig
581	    if run:
582	        info = {k: run[k] for k in ("reader", "sample", "seconds", "phases_seconds", "model_calls_by_model",
583	                                    "metered_cost_estimate", "resumed_from", "seconds_total") if run.get(k) is not None}
584	        if info:
585	            fd["run_info"] = info
586	    return fd

589	def build_county(raw: dict, sizes: dict, img_path=lambda county, n: f"data/pages/{county}-p{n}.webp",
590	                 block_path=lambda county, bid: f"data/blocks/{county}-{bid}.webp", ink=None, rules=None,
591	                 findings=None, run=None, findings_path=None, evidence=None,
592	                 crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: None, rows=None, images=None) -> dict:
593	    """The county's JSON for the page. `sizes` maps page number -> (render_w, render_h, img_w, img_h);
594	    `ink` maps (page, block, row, column) -> ink box in block-image pixels, `rules` maps (page, block) -> the y of
595	    the ruled line above the block's first row (see render_blocks); `findings` is the county's findings.json, `run`
596	    the run's run.json; `rows` the report layout's row crops (see build_rows: {rc, fx, rcix}); `images` the page numbers that
597	    have an image (None: all of them)."""
598	    ink, rules, rows = ink or {}, rules or {}, rows or {}
599	    fx = rows.get("fx") or {}
600	    county = raw["county"]
601	    pages, sc_of, frame_of = [], {}, {}
602	    for pg in raw["pages"]:
603	        n = pg["number"]
604	        if n not in sizes:
605	            raise ValueError(f"page {n} of {county} has no rendered size")
606	        rw, rh, iw, ih = sizes[n]
607	        # the boxes live in the frame of the recorded size when there is one, else of the render
608	        frame_w = pg.get("width") or rw
609	        sc = iw / frame_w
610	        sc_of[n] = sc
611	        frame_of[n] = (frame_w, rw)
612	        pages.append({"n": n, "img": img_path(county, n) if images is None or n in images else None,
613	                      "w": iw, "h": ih, "sc": round(sc, 6)})
614	
615	    values, index = [], {}
616	
617	    def add(p, b, r, c, v, box, **extra):
618	        if (p, b, r, c) in index:
619	            raise ValueError(f"value {p}:{b}:{r}:{c} appears twice in {county}")
620	        index[(p, b, r, c)] = len(values)
621	        d = {"p": p, "b": b, "r": r, "c": c, "v": v, "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(p, 1.0)),
622	             "ix": ink.get((p, b, r, c))}
623	        d.update(extra)
624	        if (p, b, r, c) in fx:
625	            d["fx"] = fx[(p, b, r, c)]
626	        values.append(d)
627	
628	    for c in raw["cells"]:
629	        add(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c["value"], c.get("box"),
630	            s=c["status"], m=c.get("model"), n=c.get("tries"))
631	    for t in raw["totals"]:
632	        add(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t["value"], t.get("box"))
633	
634	    checks = []
635	    for ch in raw["checks"]:
636	        refs = []
637	        for term in ch["terms"]:
638	            p, b, r, c = term if len(term) == 4 and not isinstance(term[0], list) else term[0]   # a key, or [key, value]
639	            k = (p, b, r, str(c))
640	            if k not in index:
641	                raise ValueError(f"check {ch['kind']} {ch['page']}:{ch['block']}:{ch['key']} names a term "
642	                                 f"{p}:{b}:{r}:{c} that is not a value")
643	            refs.append(index[k])
644	        checks.append({"k": "grand" if ch["kind"] == "grand_col" else ch["kind"], "p": ch["page"], "b": ch["block"], "y": str(ch["key"]), "ok": bool(ch["ok"]),
645	                       "pr": ch["printed"], "co": ch["computed"], "t": refs})
646	
647	    blocks = []
648	    for b in raw["blocks"]:
649	        box = b.get("box")
650	        ok = _scale_box(box, 1.0) is not None and b["page"] in frame_of
651	        bi = None
652	        if ok:
653	            _, _, w, h = block_geometry(box, *frame_of[b["page"]])
654	            bi = {"img": block_path(county, b["id"]), "w": w, "h": h, "rt": rules.get((b["page"], b["id"]))}
655	        blocks.append({"id": b["id"], "p": b["page"], "contest": b["contest"], "cand": b.get("candidate"),
656	                       "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(b["page"], 1.0)), "bi": bi})
657	    out = {"county": county, "run": raw["run_id"], "layout": raw["layout"], "pages": pages, "blocks": blocks,
658	           "values": values, "checks": checks,
659	           "events": [{"t": e["ts"], "k": e["kind"], "p": e["payload"]} for e in raw["events"]]}
660	    vd = [{"s": v.get("sum"), "v": v.get("verdict"), "r": v.get("reason"), "e": v.get("entity")}
661	          for v in raw.get("verdicts") or [] if isinstance(v, dict)]
662	    if vd:
663	        out["vd"] = vd
664	    sm = {k: raw["summary"][k] for k in ("sums_failing_before", "sums_failing_after", "items_worked", "cells_reread")
665	          if (raw.get("summary") or {}).get(k) is not None}
666	    if sm:
667	        out["sm"] = sm
668	    if rows.get("rc"):
669	        out["rc"] = rows["rc"]
670	    if findings:
671	        out["fd"] = build_findings(raw, index, findings, run, findings_path, evidence, crop_path, rows.get("rcix"))
672	    return out

692	def render_blocks(raw: dict, sizes: dict, out_dir: Path, data_root=None) -> dict:
693	    """Cuts every block that has a box out of its page at 300 dpi and saves it as a grey WebP.
694	    Returns (inks, rules): the ink box of every value that has one, {(page, block, row, column): [x0, y0, x1, y1]},
695	    and the y of the ruled line above each block's first row, {(page, block): y}, both in the pixels of the
696	    block's image."""
697	    from PIL import Image
698	    from .render import page_png
699	    from .sources import DATA
700	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
701	    county, inks, rules = raw["county"], {}, {}
702	    frames = {pg["number"]: (pg.get("width") or sizes[pg["number"]][0], sizes[pg["number"]][0]) for pg in raw["pages"]}
703	    for n in sorted({b["page"] for b in raw["blocks"] if b.get("box")}):
704	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, BLOCK_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
705	            im = im.convert("L")
706	            for b in raw["blocks"]:
707	                if b["page"] != n or not _scale_box(b.get("box"), 1.0):
708	                    continue
709	                geom = block_geometry(b["box"], *frames[n])
710	                cut = cut_block(im, geom)
711	                cut.save(out_dir / f"{county}-{b['id']}.webp", quality=82, method=6)
712	                k = frames[n][1] * BLOCK_DPI / RENDER_DPI / frames[n][0]
713	                left = max(0, min(geom[0], im.width - geom[2]))
714	                top = max(0, min(geom[1], im.height - geom[3]))
715	                first = None
716	                for rows, rk, ck in ((raw["cells"], "row_kind", "column"), (raw["totals"], "direction", "key")):
717	                    for o in rows:
718	                        if o["page"] != n or o["block"] != b["id"] or not _scale_box(o.get("box"), 1.0):
719	                            continue
720	                        cb = [o["box"][0] * k - left, o["box"][1] * k - top, o["box"][2] * k - left, o["box"][3] * k - top]
721	                        if rk == "row_kind" and (first is None or cb[1] < first[1]):
722	                            first = cb
723	                        ib = ink_box(cut, cb)
724	                        if ib:
725	                            inks[(n, b["id"], o[rk], str(o[ck]))] = ib
726	                rt = rule_top(cut, first) if first else None
727	                if rt is not None:
728	                    rules[(n, b["id"])] = rt
729	    return inks, rules

732	def total_seconds(meta: dict, runs_dir="runs"):
733	    """This run's seconds plus those of every run it resumed (`resumed_from`, followed back); None when the run, or
734	    one it resumed, did not record its seconds or its run.json cannot be found."""
735	    total, seen = 0.0, set()
736	    while meta:
737	        if not isinstance(meta.get("seconds"), (int, float)):
738	            return None
739	        total += meta["seconds"]
740	        prior = meta.get("resumed_from")
741	        if not prior:
742	            return round(total, 1)
743	        if prior in seen:
744	            return None
745	        seen.add(prior)
746	        path = Path(runs_dir) / str(prior) / "run.json"
747	        meta = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else None
748	    return None

753	    ids = sorted(p.parent.name for p in Path(runs_dir).glob("*/summary.json"))

755	        ids = sorted(p.parent.parent.name for p in Path(runs_dir).glob("*/*/findings.json"))
756	    if not ids:
757	        raise SystemExit(f"no run under {runs_dir} has a summary.json or a findings.json")
758	    return ids[-1]
759	
760	
761	def county_entry(key: str, summ: dict | None, findings: dict | None, pages: int, layout: str) -> dict:
762	    """The county's line in index.json: what the tabs and the whole-run line read. `summ` is the county's entry of the run's
763	    summary.json (None for a run that has none), `findings` its findings.json."""
764	    entry = {"key": key, "name": key.replace("_", " ").title(), "file": f"data/{key}.json", "pages": pages,
765	             "status": (summ or {}).get("status", "audited"), "layout": layout}
766	    fs = (findings or {}).get("findings") or []
767	    by = {}
768	    for f in fs:
769	        by[f["status"]] = by.get(f["status"], 0) + 1
770	    if findings is not None:
771	        entry["disagreements"] = len(fs)
772	        entry["by_status"] = by
773	        entry["confirmed"] = sum(1 for f in fs if f.get("confirmed_by_person"))
774	    sc = (summ or {}).get("sums_check") or (findings or {}).get("sums_check") or {}
775	    got = {k: sc[k] for k in ("in_all", "holding_with_published", "holding_with_corrected") if k in sc}
776	    if got:
777	        entry["sums_check"] = got
778	    second = (summ or {}).get("second_sum_exists")
779	    if second is None:
780	        second = ((findings or {}).get("audit") or {}).get("second_sum_exists")
781	    if second is not None:
782	        entry["second_sum"] = bool(second)
783	    return entry
784	
785	
786	def unchecked_entry(key: str, summ: dict | None, raw: dict | None) -> dict:
787	    """A county the run did not check: its reason (the run's own words) and no county file."""
788	    note = (summ or {}).get("note") or (raw or {}).get("note") or "nothing on this scan can be cross-checked; left as published"
789	    return {"key": key, "name": key.replace("_", " ").title(), "pages": 0, "status": "unchecked",
790	            "layout": (summ or {}).get("layout") or (raw or {}).get("layout") or "no_printed_totals", "note": note}
791

793	def run_totals(entries: list, summary: dict | None, meta: dict) -> dict:
794	    """The figures for the whole run, from the entries and the run's own totals."""
795	    read = [e for e in entries if e.get("status") != "unchecked"]
796	    by = {}
797	    for e in read:
798	        for k, n in (e.get("by_status") or {}).items():
799	            by[k] = by.get(k, 0) + n
800	    sc = lambda k: sum((e.get("sums_check") or {}).get(k, 0) for e in read)
801	    t = {"counties": len(entries), "read": len(read), "findings": sum(e.get("disagreements") or 0 for e in read),
802	         "settled": by.get("settled_against_file", 0), "cannot_verify": by.get("cannot_verify", 0),
803	         "confirmed": sum(e.get("confirmed") or 0 for e in read),
804	         "sums_in_all": sc("in_all"), "holding_published": sc("holding_with_published"),
805	         "holding_corrected": sc("holding_with_corrected")}
806	    if by.get("document_inconsistent"):
807	        t["document_inconsistent"] = by["document_inconsistent"]
808	    src = (summary or {}).get("totals") or {}
809	    for k, from_, key in (("model_calls", src, "model_calls"), ("metered_cost", src, "metered_cost"),
810	                          ("seconds", src, "seconds")):
811	        v = from_.get(key)
812	        if v is None:
813	            v = {"metered_cost": meta.get("metered_cost_estimate"), "seconds": meta.get("seconds_total", meta.get("seconds"))}.get(k, meta.get(k))
814	        if v is not None:
815	            t[k] = v
816	    return t

819	def _clear(out: Path, key: str):
820	    for sub in ("pages", "blocks", "rows", "crops"):
821	        for f in (out / sub).glob(f"{key}-*"):
822	            f.unlink()

825	def build(run_id: str, runs_dir="runs", out="site/data", counties=None, data_root=None) -> list[str]:
826	    if run_id == "latest":
827	        run_id = latest_run(runs_dir)
828	    run_dir = Path(runs_dir) / run_id
829	    out = Path(out)
830	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
831	    meta = json.loads((run_dir / "run.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "run.json").exists() else {}
832	    if meta.get("resumed_from"):
833	        tot = total_seconds(meta, runs_dir)
834	        if tot is not None:
835	            meta["seconds_total"] = tot
836	    summary = json.loads((run_dir / "summary.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "summary.json").exists() else None
837	    if summary:       # a summary run has no run.json: its own span of time stands for the run
838	        meta = {**{k: summary[k] for k in ("started", "ended") if summary.get(k)}, **meta}
839	    by_summary = {c["county"]: c for c in (summary or {}).get("counties", [])}
840	    # the run's own order when it kept one; else the folders' (alphabetical)
841	    keys = [c["county"] for c in (summary or {}).get("counties", [])] or sorted(p.parent.name for p in run_dir.glob("*/county.json"))
842	    if counties:
843	        keys = [k for k in keys if k in counties]
844	    if not keys:
845	        raise SystemExit(f"no county.json under {run_dir}")
846	    index = {"run": run_id, "started": meta.get("started"), "ended": meta.get("ended"), "counties": [], "summary": {},
847	             "run_totals": {k: meta[k] for k in ("model_calls", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens",
848	                                                 "metered_cost_estimate") if k in meta}}
849	    for key in keys:
850	        summ = by_summary.get(key)
851	        # a summary run names the run each county's figures come from
852	        cdir = Path(runs_dir) / str((summ or {}).get("from_run") or run_id) / key
853	        raw = json.loads((cdir / "county.json").read_text())
854	        if (summ or {}).get("status") == "unchecked" or raw.get("layout") == "no_printed_totals":
855	            index["counties"].append(unchecked_entry(key, summ, raw))
856	            continue
857	        _clear(out, key)
858	        fpath = cdir / "findings.json"
859	        findings = json.loads(fpath.read_text()) if fpath.exists() else None
860	        report = raw.get("layout") == "report"
861	        rows, images = None, None
862	        if report:
863	            # the page images of a report county are written only for the pages that carry a finding, and page 1
864	            images = {1} | {f["page"] for f in (findings or {}).get("findings", []) if f.get("page")}
865	            images &= {p["number"] for p in raw["pages"]}
866	            sizes = frame_sizes(raw)
867	            sizes.update(render_pages(key, sorted(images), out / "pages", data_root))
868	            crops, tots = wanted_rows(raw, findings)
869	            from PIL import Image
870	            from .render import page_png
871	            from .sources import DATA
872	            frame = {p["number"]: p.get("width") or sizes[p["number"]][0] for p in raw["pages"]}
873	
874	            def im_of(n, _k=key):
875	                with Image.open(page_png(_k, n, CROP_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
876	                    return im.convert("L")
877	            rc, fx, rcix = build_rows(raw, crops, tots, im_of, frame.get, lambda n: sizes[n][2] / frame[n], out / "rows",
878	                                      lambda county, n: f"data/rows/{county}-r{n}.webp")
879	            rows = {"rc": rc, "fx": fx, "rcix": rcix}
880	            inks, rules = {}, {}
881	        else:
882	            sizes = render_pages(key, [p["number"] for p in raw["pages"]], out / "pages", data_root)
883	            inks, rules = render_blocks(raw, sizes, out / "blocks", data_root)
884	        crops_dir = out / "crops"
885	
886	        def crop_path(county, gid, src, _dir=cdir):
887	            if not src or not (_dir / src).exists():
888	                return None
889	            crops_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
890	            shutil.copyfile(_dir / src, crops_dir / f"{county}-{gid}.png")
891	            return f"data/crops/{county}-{gid}.png"
892	
893	        run = dict(meta)
894	        for src, dst in (("seconds", "seconds"), ("metered_cost", "metered_cost_estimate"), ("model_calls_by_model", "model_calls_by_model"),
895	                         ("reader", "reader")):
896	            if (summ or {}).get(src) is not None:      # a run of every county: the county's own figures, not the run's
897	                run[dst] = summ[src]
898	        if raw.get("sample") and not run.get("sample"):
899	            run["sample"] = raw["sample"]
900	        d = build_county(raw, sizes, ink=inks, rules=rules, findings=findings, run=run,
901	                         findings_path=fpath.as_posix() if findings else None,
902	                         evidence=f"data/{key}-findings.json" if findings else None, crop_path=crop_path,
903	                         rows=rows, images=images)
904	        if findings:
905	            shutil.copyfile(fpath, out / f"{key}-findings.json")
906	        (out / f"{key}.json").write_text(json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":")))
907	        index["counties"].append(county_entry(key, summ, findings, len(d["pages"]), raw.get("layout") or ""))
908	        index["summary"][key] = raw.get("summary", {})
909	    if counties and (out / "index.json").exists():
910	        # a build of some counties keeps the entries of the others that an earlier build of this run wrote
911	        old = json.loads((out / "index.json").read_text())
912	        if old.get("run") == run_id:
913	            built = {c["key"] for c in index["counties"]}
914	            mine = {c["key"]: c for c in index["counties"]}
915	            mine.update({c["key"]: c for c in old["counties"] if c["key"] not in built})
916	            order = [c["county"] for c in (summary or {}).get("counties", [])] or sorted(mine)
917	            index["counties"] = [mine[k] for k in order if k in mine]
918	            index["summary"] = {**old.get("summary", {}), **index["summary"]}
919	    index["totals"] = run_totals(index["counties"], summary, meta)
920	    (out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, separators=(",", ":")))
921	    return keys
922	
923	
924	def frame_sizes(raw: dict, max_width=MAX_WIDTH) -> dict:
925	    """The sizes of the pages without rendering them: (frame_w, frame_h, img_w, img_h) from the sizes the run recorded."""
926	    out = {}
927	    for pg in raw["pages"]:
928	        w, h = pg.get("width"), pg.get("height")
929	        if not w or not h:
930	            raise ValueError(f"page {pg['number']} of {raw['county']} has no recorded size")
931	        iw = min(max_width, w)
932	        out[pg["number"]] = (w, h, iw, round(h * iw / w))

936	def main(argv=None):
