"""Write the README's tables from the final run's files, so no figure in them is typed by hand.

    python3 tools/readme_tables.py            rewrite the blocks between <!-- name:start --> and <!-- name:end --> in README.md
    python3 tools/readme_tables.py --check    exit 1 if README.md differs from what the files give

Reads runs/<run>/summary.json (the newest run with one, or --run) and, for the picture, the findings.json and crop of the
run that the summary names for Panola."""
import argparse, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FULL_RUN = "20261011-120008"          # the one full run of Panola from nothing, named in the README
PICTURE = ("panola", "f005")          # a settled finding whose crop shows the cell and the row sum


def latest_summary() -> str:
    ids = sorted(p.parent.name for p in (ROOT / "runs").glob("*/summary.json"))
    return ids[-1]


def n(v) -> str:
    return f"{v:,}"


def findings_table(s: dict) -> str:
    head = ("| County | Layout | Published rows compared | Disagreements | Settled by the printed totals | Cannot be verified "
            "| Printed sums in all | Holding with the published file | Holding with the corrected file |\n"
            "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    rows = []
    for c in s["counties"]:
        name = c["county"].replace("_", " ").title()
        if c["status"] != "audited":
            rows.append(f"| {name} | {c['layout']} | not checked: nothing printed on the scan can be summed | | | | | | |")
            continue
        sc, st = c["sums_check"], c["findings_by_status"]
        rows.append(f"| {name} | {c['layout']} | {n(c['rows_compared'])} of {n(c['rows_published'])} | {n(sum(st.values()))} "
                    f"| {n(st.get('settled_against_file', 0))} | {n(st.get('cannot_verify', 0))} | {n(sc['in_all'])} "
                    f"| {n(sc['holding_with_published'])} | {n(sc['holding_with_corrected'])} |")
    t = s["totals"]
    st, sc = t["findings_by_status"], t["sums_check"]
    rows.append(f"| **All** | | {n(t['rows_compared'])} of {n(t['rows_published'])} | {n(sum(st.values()))} "
                f"| {n(st.get('settled_against_file', 0))} | {n(st.get('cannot_verify', 0))} | {n(sc['in_all'])} "
                f"| {n(sc['holding_with_published'])} | {n(sc['holding_with_corrected'])} |")
    return "\n".join([head, *rows])


def cost_table(s: dict) -> str:
    head = "| County | Pages | Model calls | Metered cost (estimate) | Seconds |\n|---|---|---|---|---|"
    rows = [f"| {c['county'].replace('_', ' ').title()} | {c['pages']} | {c['model_calls']} | ${c['metered_cost']:.4f} | {c['seconds']} |"
            for c in s["counties"]]
    t = s["totals"]
    rows.append(f"| **All** | {sum(c['pages'] for c in s['counties'])} | {t['model_calls']} | ${t['metered_cost']:.4f} | {t['seconds']} |")
    full = json.loads((ROOT / "runs" / FULL_RUN / "run.json").read_text())
    note = (f"These are the figures of the audit that `summary.json` lists for each county; a county audited again from an "
            f"earlier run's ledger counts the new calls only, not the reading that was paid for in that earlier run. The one "
            f"full run of Panola from nothing, [`runs/{FULL_RUN}/run.json`](runs/{FULL_RUN}/run.json), took "
            f"{full['seconds']} seconds, {full['model_calls']} model calls and ${full['metered_cost_estimate']:.2f} (metered estimate).")
    return "\n".join([head, *rows, "", note])


def picture(s: dict) -> str:
    county, fid = PICTURE
    run = next(c["from_run"] for c in s["counties"] if c["county"] == county)
    base = f"runs/{run}/{county}"
    doc = json.loads((ROOT / base / "findings.json").read_text())
    f = next(x for x in doc["findings"] if x["id"] == fid)
    row = next(x for x in f["sums"] if x["kind"] == "row")
    part = f["part"].replace("_", " ")
    return (f"![crop of the scan: {f['candidate']}, precinct {f['precinct']}, the cell outlined]({base}/{f['crop']})\n\n"
            f"*Panola County, page {f['page']}, {f['candidate']}, precinct {f['precinct']}, {part}. The published file has "
            f"{f['file_value']}; the scan has {f['scan_value']}. The row's printed total is {row['printed']}: the cells add to "
            f"{row['computed_with_scan']} with the scan's value and to {row['computed_with_file']} with the file's, so the printed "
            f"total decides (finding {fid} in [{base}/findings.json]({base}/findings.json); not confirmed by a person).*")


def blocks(run: str) -> dict:
    s = json.loads((ROOT / "runs" / run / "summary.json").read_text())
    return {"table": findings_table(s), "cost": cost_table(s), "picture": picture(s), "run": f"`runs/{run}`"}


def apply(text: str, b: dict) -> str:
    for name, body in b.items():
        text = re.sub(rf"(<!-- {name}:start -->\n).*?(<!-- {name}:end -->)", lambda m: m.group(1) + body + "\n" + m.group(2), text, flags=re.S)
    return text


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--run", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    run = a.run or latest_summary()
    path = ROOT / "README.md"
    old = path.read_text()
    new = apply(old, blocks(run))
    if a.check:
        print("README figures match the files" if new == old else "README figures differ from the files")
        return 0 if new == old else 1
    path.write_text(new)
    print(f"README.md blocks written from runs/{run}/summary.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	"""List every run id and qa path that the documents name, and whether it still exists in the tree.
2	
3	    python3 tools/named_paths.py          print the table
4	    python3 tools/named_paths.py --check  exit 1 if a named run folder (or a path under it) or qa path is missing
5	
6	Documents read: README.md, hackathon.md, docs/, .prod-build/reports/, tests/. A run id counts as present when runs/<id> exists;
7	a path like runs/<id>/<rest> counts as present when that file exists. Lines that say "not committed", raw diff-stat lines of
8	old reports and the made-up ids in tests/ are skipped."""
9	import re, sys
10	from pathlib import Path
11	
12	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
13	SOURCES = ["README.md", "hackathon.md", "docs", ".prod-build/reports", "tests"]
14	RUN = re.compile(r"\b(2026\d{4}-\d{6})\b")
15	RUNPATH = re.compile(r"runs/(2026\d{4}-\d{6})/([\w./*<>-]+)")
16	QA = re.compile(r"(?<![\w/])qa/[\w./-]+")
17	
18	
19	def files():
20	    for s in SOURCES:
21	        p = ROOT / s
22	        for f in ([p] if p.is_file() else sorted(p.rglob("*"))):
23	            if f.is_file() and f.suffix in {".md", ".py", ".txt", ".json", ".mjs"} and "__pycache__" not in f.parts and "score" != f.stem:
24	                yield f
25	
26	
27	def scan():
28	    runs, paths, qa = {}, {}, {}
29	    for f in files():
30	        for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
31	            rel = f.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
32	            if "not committed" in line or "deleted" in line or re.search(r"\|\s+\d+\s+[+-]*\s*$", line) or rel.startswith("tests/"):
33	                continue      # a run said not to be committed, a raw `git diff --stat` line (history), a test's made-up ids
34	            for m in RUN.finditer(line):
35	                runs.setdefault(m.group(1), set()).add(rel)
36	            for m in RUNPATH.finditer(line):
37	                if not re.search(r"[*<>]", m.group(2)):
38	                    paths.setdefault(f"runs/{m.group(1)}/{m.group(2).rstrip('.,;:)')}", set()).add(rel)
39	            for m in QA.finditer(line):
40	                qa.setdefault(m.group(0).rstrip(".,;:)"), set()).add(rel)
41	    return runs, paths, qa
42	
43	
44	def main(argv=None) -> int:
45	    runs, paths, qa = scan()
46	    bad = []
47	    print("run ids named, and whether runs/<id> exists:")
48	    for r in sorted(runs):
49	        ok = (ROOT / "runs" / r).is_dir()
50	        print(f"  {r}  {'present' if ok else 'MISSING'}  ({len(runs[r])} file(s))")
51	        if not ok:
52	            bad.append(r)
53	    print("paths under runs/ named:")
54	    for p in sorted(paths):
55	        ok = (ROOT / p).exists()
56	        if not ok:
57	            bad.append(p)
58	        print(f"  {p}  {'present' if ok else 'MISSING'}")
59	    print("qa paths named:")
60	    for p in sorted(qa):
61	        ok = (ROOT / p).exists()
62	        if not ok:
63	            bad.append(p)
64	        print(f"  {p}  {'present' if ok else 'MISSING'}")
65	    print(f"{len(bad)} named path(s) missing")
66	    return 1 if (bad and "--check" in (argv or sys.argv[1:])) else 0
67	
68	
69	if __name__ == "__main__":
70	    sys.exit(main())

"""The page build: it fetches a scan that is missing, says one plain line when it cannot, and never leaves site/data/ half
written. No network, no model: fakes stand in for the downloader and the renderer."""
import json

import pytest

from crossfoot import cli, sitebuild, sources


def raw(county):
    return {"county": county, "run_id": "r1", "layout": "matrix", "pages": [{"number": 1, "width": 100, "height": 100}],
            "blocks": [], "cells": [], "totals": [], "checks": [], "events": [], "summary": {}}


@pytest.fixture
def runs(tmp_path):
    root = tmp_path / "runs"
    for c in ("alpha", "beta"):
        (root / "r1" / c).mkdir(parents=True)
        (root / "r1" / c / "county.json").write_text(json.dumps(raw(c)))
    (root / "r1" / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "run_id": "r1", "counties": [{"county": "alpha", "status": "audited"}, {"county": "beta", "status": "audited"}],
        "totals": {}}))
    return root


@pytest.fixture
def fake_render(monkeypatch):
    def pages(county, numbers, out_dir, data_root=None, max_width=1600):
        if county == "beta" and FAIL.get("beta"):
            raise RuntimeError("renderer broke half way")
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (out_dir / f"{county}-p1.webp").write_bytes(b"new-" + county.encode())
        return {1: (100, 100, 100, 100)}
    FAIL.clear()
    monkeypatch.setattr(sitebuild, "render_pages", pages)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sitebuild, "render_blocks", lambda raw, sizes, out_dir, data_root=None: ({}, {}))


FAIL = {}


def tree(root):
    return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): p.read_bytes() for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}


def old_site(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "site" / "data"
    (out / "pages").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "blocks").mkdir()
    (out / "index.json").write_text('{"run":"old"}')
    (out / "pages" / "alpha-p1.webp").write_bytes(b"old image")
    (out / "blocks" / "alpha-b1.webp").write_bytes(b"old block")
    return out


def test_a_build_that_fails_half_way_leaves_the_old_files(tmp_path, runs, fake_render):
    out = old_site(tmp_path)
    before = tree(out)
    FAIL["beta"] = True
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(out), data_root=tmp_path / "data", fetch=lambda key, root=None: [])
    assert tree(out) == before
    assert not [p for p in tmp_path.glob("site/*") if p.name != "data"], "no staging folder is left beside site/data"


def test_a_good_build_replaces_site_data_whole(tmp_path, runs, fake_render):
    out = old_site(tmp_path)
    keys = sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(out), data_root=tmp_path / "data", fetch=lambda key, root=None: [])
    assert keys == ["alpha", "beta"]
    t = tree(out)
    assert t["pages/alpha-p1.webp"] == b"new-alpha" and "blocks/alpha-b1.webp" not in t
    assert json.loads(t["index.json"])["run"] == "r1"


def test_a_scan_that_is_not_in_data_is_fetched_once_per_county(tmp_path, runs, fake_render):
    asked = []

    def fetch(key, root=None):
        asked.append(key)
        return ["scan"]
    lines = []
    sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(tmp_path / "out"), data_root=tmp_path / "data", fetch=fetch, log=lines.append)
    assert asked == ["alpha", "beta"]
    assert len(lines) == 2 and "alpha" in lines[0] and "beta" in lines[1]


def test_a_scan_already_there_is_not_fetched(tmp_path, runs, fake_render):
    for c in ("alpha", "beta"):
        p = sources.scan_path(c, tmp_path / "data")
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(b"%PDF")
    asked = []
    sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(tmp_path / "out"), data_root=tmp_path / "data",
                    fetch=lambda key, root=None: asked.append(key), log=lambda s: None)
    assert asked == []


def test_a_failed_download_is_one_plain_line_and_exit_1(tmp_path, runs, fake_render, monkeypatch, capsys):
    out = old_site(tmp_path)
    before = tree(out)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    def fetch(key, root=None):
        raise sources.FetchError(f"could not download https://example.invalid/{key}.pdf: offline")
    monkeypatch.setattr(sources, "fetch", fetch)
    rc = cli.main(["site", "build", "--run", "r1", "--runs-dir", str(runs), "--out", str(out)])
    err = capsys.readouterr().err.strip().splitlines()
    assert rc == 1 and len(err) == 1
    assert "alpha" in err[0] and "https://example.invalid/alpha.pdf" in err[0] and "Traceback" not in err[0]
    assert tree(out) == before


def test_a_partial_build_keeps_the_other_counties_of_the_same_run(tmp_path, runs, fake_render):
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(out), data_root=tmp_path / "data", fetch=lambda key, root=None: [], log=lambda s: None)
    sitebuild.build("r1", str(runs), str(out), counties=["beta"], data_root=tmp_path / "data",
                    fetch=lambda key, root=None: [], log=lambda s: None)
    t = tree(out)
    assert "pages/alpha-p1.webp" in t and "pages/beta-p1.webp" in t
    assert [c["key"] for c in json.loads(t["index.json"])["counties"]] == ["alpha", "beta"]

def combine(out, base: str, use: dict, command: str = "") -> dict:
    """A new run folder whose summary covers every county of run `base` with the newest result of each: a county in `use`
    ({county: run id}) takes its audit from that run's folder, the others stay as `base` has them. Every row says which run its
    figures come from. Nothing is read and no model is called; the runs it names are not changed."""
    out = Path(out)
    root = out.parent
    old = json.loads((root / base / "summary.json").read_text())
    rows = []
    for r in old["counties"]:
        run = use.get(r["county"]) or r.get("from_run") or base       # a base that is itself a summary names each row's run
        row = _row_from_folder(root / run, r["county"], r) if r["county"] in use else dict(r)
        rows.append({**row, "from_run": run})
    now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    summary = {"run_id": out.name, "command": command, "budget": old["budget"], "started": now, "ended": now,
               "resumed": False, "counties": rows, "totals": totals(rows), "not_reached": [],
               "skipped": [{"county": r["county"], "reason": r.get("note") or r.get("reason") or r["status"]}
                           for r in rows if r["status"] in ("unchecked", "failed", "stopped")],
               "made_from": {"base": base, "use": use}}
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write_summary(out, summary)
    return summary

"""A summary keeps, per county, what the run that read it cost and what the later audits added; the totals do the same."""
import json

from crossfoot import allrun


def row(county, calls, cost, secs, **kw):
    return {"county": county, "status": "audited", "layout": "matrix", "model_calls": calls, "metered_cost": cost,
            "seconds": secs, "model_calls_by_model": {"m": {"calls": calls, "prompt_tokens": 0, "completion_tokens": 0,
                                                           "cost": cost}}, **kw}


def write(root, run_id, rows, **kw):
    d = root / run_id
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    t = allrun.totals(rows)
    (d / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({"run_id": run_id, "budget": 9.0, "counties": rows, "totals": t,
                                                "not_reached": [], "skipped": [], **kw}))


def test_the_reading_run_and_the_audits_made_again_are_kept_apart(tmp_path):
    write(tmp_path, "r0", [row("a", 100, 1.0, 100.0), row("b", 10, 0.5, 20.0)])
    write(tmp_path, "r1", [row("a", 4, 0.01, 5.0, from_run="x1"), row("b", 10, 0.5, 20.0, from_run="r0")],
          made_from={"base": "r0", "use": {"a": "x1"}})
    write(tmp_path, "r2", [row("a", 1, 0.002, 2.0, from_run="x2"), row("b", 10, 0.5, 20.0, from_run="r0")],
          made_from={"base": "r1", "use": {"a": "x2"}})
    s = allrun.combine(tmp_path / "r3", "r2", {}, command="t")
    a, b = s["counties"]
    assert a["read_run"]["run_id"] == "r0" and a["read_run"]["model_calls"] == 100 and a["read_run"]["seconds"] == 100.0
    assert a["audit_again"]["run_ids"] == ["x1", "x2"] and a["audit_again"]["model_calls"] == 5
    assert a["audit_again"]["metered_cost"] == 0.012 and a["audit_again"]["seconds"] == 7.0
    assert a["model_calls"] == 105 and a["seconds"] == 107.0           # the row's own figures add both
    assert b["read_run"]["model_calls"] == 10 and "audit_again" not in b
    t = s["totals"]
    assert t["read_run"]["model_calls"] == 110 and t["audit_again"]["model_calls"] == 5
    md = (tmp_path / "r3" / "summary.md").read_text()
    assert md.index("read: calls") < md.index("audit again: calls")


def test_a_second_summary_of_a_summary_adds_nothing_twice(tmp_path):
    write(tmp_path, "r0", [row("a", 100, 1.0, 100.0)])
    write(tmp_path, "r1", [row("a", 4, 0.01, 5.0, from_run="x1")], made_from={"base": "r0", "use": {"a": "x1"}})
    s1 = allrun.combine(tmp_path / "r2", "r1", {}, command="t")
    s2 = allrun.combine(tmp_path / "r3", "r2", {}, command="t")
    assert s1["counties"][0]["audit_again"] == s2["counties"][0]["audit_again"]
    assert s2["counties"][0]["model_calls"] == 104
E

            f"| ${c['read_run']['metered_cost']:.4f} | {c['read_run']['seconds']} | {again(c.get('audit_again'))} |"
            for c in s["counties"]]
    t = s["totals"]
    r = t["read_run"]
    rows.append(f"| **All** | {sum(c['pages'] for c in s['counties'])} | {r['model_calls']} | ${r['metered_cost']:.4f} "
                f"| {r['seconds']} | {again(t.get('audit_again'))} |")
    run = s["counties"][0]["read_run"]["run_id"]
    checked = [c for c in s["counties"] if c["status"] != "unchecked"]
    dear = max(checked, key=lambda c: c["read_run"]["metered_cost"])
    cheap = min(checked, key=lambda c: c["read_run"]["metered_cost"])
    name = lambda c: c["county"].replace("_", " ").title()

                     f"{c['read_run']['seconds']} seconds)")

            f"(`summary.json` keeps both under `read_run` and `audit_again`). An audit from nothing costs, for the dearest "
            f"checked county, {fig(dear)}, and for the cheapest, {fig(cheap)}; Limestone, which prints nothing to add up, took "
            f"{next(c for c in s['counties'] if c['county'] == 'limestone')['read_run']['model_calls']} call to be listed as not checked.")
    return "\\n".join([head, *rows, "", note])

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from lib import *
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

W, M = ("1440", (1440, 900)), ("390", (390, 844))
STATES = [("panola-open", ""), ("san-saba-open", "?county=san_saba"), ("san-saba-cannot-verify", "?county=san_saba&finding=f003"),
          ("jones-settled", "?county=jones&finding=f009"), ("jones-cannot-verify", "?county=jones&finding=f001"),
          ("lynn-wrong-column", "?county=lynn&finding=f004"), ("cottle-empty", "?county=cottle"), ("limestone-not-checked", "?county=limestone"),
          ("scurry-open", "?county=scurry")]

def states(b):
    for name, q in STATES:
        for tag, size in (W, M):
            ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, q, wait=3000)
            pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{name}-{tag}.png")); print(name, tag, errs); ctx.close()

def tabs(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=jones", wait=2500)
        pg.locator("#tabs [aria-selected=true]").focus()
        pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-{tag}.png"), clip={"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": size[0], "height": 140})
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-full-{tag}.png"))
        print("tabs", tag, "focused:", pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent"), "stops:", pg.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button')].filter(b => b.tabIndex === 0).length"), errs)
        ctx.close()

def replay(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=san_saba", wait=2500)
        pg.get_by_role("button", name="Replay the audit").click()
        pg.wait_for_function("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent.startsWith('Page 2: the printed sum')", timeout=60000)
        pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); pg.keyboard.press("Escape"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"san-saba-replay-{tag}.png")); print("replay", tag, pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent"), errs)
        ctx.close()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    for name, fn in (("states", states), ("tabs", tabs), ("replay", replay)):
        if not only or name in only: fn(b)
    b.close()

STATES = [("panola-open", ""), ("san-saba-open", "?county=san_saba"), ("san-saba-cannot-verify", "?county=san_saba&finding=f003"),
          ("jones-settled", "?county=jones&finding=f009"), ("jones-cannot-verify", "?county=jones&finding=f001"),
          ("lynn-wrong-column", "?county=lynn&finding=f004"), ("cottle-empty", "?county=cottle"), ("limestone-not-checked", "?county=limestone"),
          ("scurry-open", "?county=scurry")]

def states(b):
    for name, q in STATES:
        for tag, size in (W, M):
            ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, q, wait=3000)
            pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{name}-{tag}.png")); print(name, tag, errs); ctx.close()

def tabs(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=jones", wait=2500)
        pg.locator("#tabs [aria-selected=true]").focus()
        pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-{tag}.png"), clip={"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": size[0], "height": 140})
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-full-{tag}.png"))
        print("tabs", tag, "focused:", pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent"), "stops:", pg.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button')].filter(b => b.tabIndex === 0).length"), errs)
        ctx.close()

def replay(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=san_saba", wait=2500)
        pg.get_by_role("button", name="Replay the audit").click()
        pg.wait_for_function("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent.startsWith('Page 2: the printed sum')", timeout=60000)
        pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); pg.keyboard.press("Escape"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"san-saba-replay-{tag}.png")); print("replay", tag, pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent"), errs)
        ctx.close()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    for name, fn in (("states", states), ("tabs", tabs), ("replay", replay)):
        if not only or name in only: fn(b)
    b.close()

  traceback (the scan `data/scans/panola.pdf` was missing) after it had already deleted the files under `site/data/blocks/`; and
  the README's cost table, the summary and the page gave, for each county, the figures of the last audit made again from an
  existing ledger (Panola 8 calls, $0.0118, 41.5 s), not those of the run that read the county.
- **Page build.** It now downloads a scan that is not in `data/` (`sources.fetch`, one line per county), builds into
  `site/data.new/` and swaps it in only when every county was built; a failure removes the new folder and leaves `site/data/`
  as it was. A failed download is one line naming the county and the URL, exit code 1. `tests/test_site_build_safe.py` (red first,
  E0100) covers a build that fails half way, a missing scan, a present scan, a failed download and a build of one county.
- **Other commands.** `tests/test_cli_missing_input.py` runs `fetch`, `filecheck`, `render`, `read`, `read-page`, `close`, `audit`
  (matrix, report, `--all --resume`), `summarize`, `score`, `verify-known` and `site build` with the input missing and the
  downloader faked to fail: each prints one line and exits 1. Three ended in a traceback before: `summarize` with no base summary,
  `score` with no claims file, and `read-page` with no scan; fixed.
- **Cost and time.** `crossfoot summarize` now keeps per county `read_run` (the run that read the scan, from its own summary) and
  `audit_again` (the later audits from that ledger, added up), and the totals do the same; `summary.md` shows the reading first.
  New final summary `runs/20261011-150000` (no model calls; the committed runs are unchanged). Its totals, from the files:
  the reading run `20261011-130414` 552 calls, $2.8692, 1,671.3 s; audits made again 209 calls, $0.2888, 767.0 s. Panola: read
  168 calls, $0.7675, 474.9 s; later audits 8 calls, $0.0118, 41.5 s. Jones: read 144 calls, $0.3844, 346.3 s; later audits 122
  calls, $0.1363, 297.1 s. The audit ids inside `audit_again` are taken from the earlier summaries (`20261011-140000`,
  `20261011-141300`); some of those run folders were removed in T08, so their figures survive only in those summaries.
- **README table** is written from it by `tools/readme_tables.py` (the results table did not change). **Page**: a county's
  `model cost` and `minutes` are the reading run's plus the later audits'; the replay's label divides those seconds by the
  replay's length (Panola 17x, Jones 16x; Jones read 1x before). Measured in the browser at 1440x900: `qa/final/costs.json`
  (page text and county file side by side) and `qa/final/*-run-numbers-1440.png`.
- **Paths check.** `tools/named_paths.py --check` skips a bullet that says something was removed or renamed; `qa/final/checks.json`
  now exists (`tools/qa/check.py` wrote it). `runs/20261011-140000` is kept: this log names it and `summarize` follows it back.
- Not measured: the cost of an audit from nothing for a county other than as the one unattended run recorded it.

'''
